style: Bold flat graphic illustration in a modern Scandinavian poster style, like a screenprinted Finnish textile or a mid-century Nordic travel poster: large confident flat colour shapes with crisp clean vector edges, no outlines, no brush strokes, no watercolour, no paper texture, only a very fine even print grain. Skies are smooth gradients built from wide horizontal bands that blend softly into each other. Strong readable silhouettes and oversized simple forms (a huge sun or moon disc, big rounded fells, tall flat triangular spruces, white birch trunks with short black dashes), minimal detail, generous empty space, a calm balanced composition, orthographic side view with a low horizon. The only character is a small faceless hooded wanderer built from two simple shapes: a tall rounded cloak and a pointed hood, no face, no visible hands, carrying a small lantern. Limited palette, at most six colours per image, chosen from: night ink #0E1433, deep indigo #1B2457, violet #3D2F80, snow #F3F0E8, gold #FFC23D, ice blue #4FB3F0, deep fjord #1C4FA0, aurora green #36D39A, deep pine #0B5C4B, apricot #FF9A62, lilac #B8A4FF. No red anywhere. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no watermark, no faces.
isolated: Isolated element on a fully transparent background, nothing else in the image.
backdrop: Full-bleed portrait image that fills the entire frame edge to edge, no frame, no border, no vignette, no device mockup, no user interface.

suffixes.icon: Square app icon artwork, full-bleed square that fills the frame edge to edge, no rounded corners, no border, no shadow, no device mockup.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_hero
assets.prompt: Key art of a winter morning on a small Finnish island at the exact moment of sunrise. A huge flat gold #FFC23D sun disc, about half the image width, rises behind a broad rounded snow-white fell whose top sits at 60 percent of the image height. The sky above is built from wide smooth horizontal bands: night ink at the very top, then deep indigo, violet, lilac, apricot and gold near the horizon, with three thin flat aurora green ribbons fading out high up and a few tiny white star dots still in the dark top band. In the middle distance a row of flat tall spruce triangles in deep pine, and a frozen lake as a flat ice-blue band with one long gold reflection stripe. In the foreground the small hooded wanderer in a deep indigo cloak walks to the right along a flat snow band, small in the frame (about 8 percent of the image height), lantern held forward with a warm gold glow. Three slender white birches with short black dashes stand tall at the left edge, cut off by the top border. Bold, joyful, hopeful and quiet.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_bite
assets.prompt: A wordless ice-fishing scene at night on a frozen lake, seen exactly from the side. A huge pale moon disc in snow #F3F0E8 hangs in a deep indigo sky above a low row of flat deep pine spruce triangles on the far shore. The lower half is a flat ice-blue frozen lake band with one oval dark hole in the ice near the centre; in the hole a small round gold float sits still, surrounded by three perfectly concentric thin rings of ice-blue light like a target. The small hooded wanderer sits on a flat wooden box at the left holding a long thin fishing rod whose line drops straight into the hole, and the lantern stands beside it on the ice with a soft round gold glow. A large calm empty area of sky above. Graphic, suspenseful but calm, like a still poster.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_start
assets.prompt: The last minutes of polar night before a morning ritual begins. Sky in smooth horizontal bands from night ink at the top through deep indigo to a thin violet band at the horizon at 55 percent of the image height, a dozen tiny crisp white star dots, one thin flat aurora green ribbon high up. A big rounded fell in soft lilac-grey silhouette on the horizon with a row of small flat dark spruce triangles. On a small flat snow mound just above the middle of the image, the small hooded wanderer sits still with the lantern beside it, the lantern only a small gold ember with a soft round glow. The lower 38 percent of the image is a calm flat deep indigo snowfield with only a few long subtle horizontal stripes of slightly lighter indigo, completely empty, reserved for interface elements. Quiet, expectant, about to begin.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_transition
assets.prompt: One moment in the middle of a night-to-dawn transition, shown as a bold graphic poster. The same island landscape is split by one crisp slightly diagonal vertical edge. Left of the edge it is still polar night: every shape flat dark indigo and cool grey, small white star dots in the sky. Right of the edge the picture has already turned to full morning colour: smooth horizontal sky bands of lilac, apricot and gold, a gold sun disc just above a white rounded fell, an ice-blue frozen lake, deep pine spruce triangles and white birches with black dashes. The colour edge is a clean straight wipe, like a new screenprint colour layer being pulled across the picture, with a thin glowing gold line along its leading edge. The small hooded wanderer stands right on the edge with the lantern raised, as if the colour flows out of the lantern. Strong, simple, magical.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_icon_a
assets.prompt: A bold mobile app icon in flat graphic vector style. Solid night ink #0E1433 background. A large flat gold #FFC23D circle, horizontally centred, about 58 percent of the icon width, half risen: its lower half is hidden behind four flat horizontal stripes of equal height that fill the lower part of the icon edge to edge, from top to bottom ice blue #4FB3F0, aurora green #36D39A, apricot #FF9A62 and lilac #B8A4FF, each stripe with crisp straight edges and small even gaps of night ink between them. Nothing else: no figure, no stars, no texture, no gradient, perfectly symmetric, readable at 40 pixels.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_icon_b
assets.prompt: A bold mobile app icon in flat graphic vector style. Solid deep indigo #1B2457 background. A large flat gold #FFC23D circle, centred, about 62 percent of the icon width. In front of the lower part of the circle, a broad flat rounded snow-white hill #F3F0E8 runs across the full width of the icon from edge to edge. Standing on top of the hill in the exact centre, in front of the gold circle, the small hooded wanderer as a single flat night ink #0E1433 silhouette: a tall rounded cloak and a pointed hood, no face, about 30 percent of the icon height, holding a short pole forward with one tiny round lantern that glows apricot. Only these four flat shapes, no texture, no stars, no gradients, readable at 40 pixels.

assets.name: concept/concept_ng_bite_v2
assets.prompt: A wordless ice-fishing scene at night on a frozen lake, seen exactly from the side, as a bold flat graphic poster. A huge pale moon disc in snow #F3F0E8 hangs in a sky of smooth horizontal bands from night ink at the top to deep indigo and a thin violet band at the horizon, a few tiny white star dots. Near the centre of the ice is one oval dark hole; in it a small round gold float sits still, surrounded by three perfectly concentric thin ice-blue rings like a target. The small hooded wanderer sits on a low flat wooden box at the left, seen from the side facing right, the hood interior solid dark with no eyes and no face, holding a long thin fishing rod whose line drops straight into the hole; the lantern stands on the ice beside it with a soft round gold glow. assets.name: concept/concept_ng_icon_c
assets.prompt: A bold, minimal mobile app icon in flat graphic vector style, only five flat shapes, centred and symmetric. Solid deep indigo #1B2457 background. At the bottom, a broad smooth snow-white #F3F0E8 dome, a perfect wide half-ellipse whose top reaches 42 percent up the icon and which runs off the left and right edges. A flat gold #FFC23D sun disc, about 46 percent of the icon width, is half hidden behind the dome, perfectly centred. Above the sun, one thick concentric arc band of aurora green #36D39A with an even gap of indigo between it and the sun, like a rainbow arc. On the top of the dome, slightly left of centre, a tiny solid night ink #0E1433 silhouette shaped like a simple rounded cone with a soft pointed tip (a little hooded wanderer, no face, no hat brim, not a witch), about 12 percent of the icon height, with one small apricot #FF9A62 dot beside it for a lantern. No texture, no gradients, no stars, no outlines, readable at 40 pixels.
